attributes.name: Mongrel Traitor
attributes.powers:
The difficulty to defeat the Mongrel Traitor is equal to the highest difficulty to defeat of a random monster from the box.

If undefeated, bury 1 random card from your discard pile.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
